note: Uniswap fee switch (repo Uniswap/protocol-fees): searcher pays a fixed threshold of UNI (burned; on Base bridged UNI) to the Releaser (Firepit) and receives the full TokenJar balance of up to 20 chosen assets. Amounts here are NOT profit: assets_len is the number of assets released; value = same-tx Transfers from the TokenJar (eth 0xf38521f130fcCF29dB1961597bc5d2B60F995f85, arb 0x95E337C5B155385945D407f5396387D0c2a3A263, base 0x9bD25e67bF390437C8fAF480AC735a27BcF6168c) minus threshold UNI. infra/uniswap-fee-releaser.md
